title: Expanding the genetic landscape of moyamoya angiopathy: insights from 74 trios
title_zh: 扩展茧状动脉病的遗传图谱：来自74个三倍体家系的见解
abstract: Abstract Moyamoya angiopathy (MMA) is a rare cerebrovascular disorder characterized by progressive stenosis of intracranial arteries and the development of abnormal collateral vessels. While RNF213 is a major susceptibility gene in East Asian populations, the genetic architecture of MMA beyond RNF213, particularly in Europeans, remains largely undefined beyond a few known syndromic causes. We performed whole-exome sequencing on 74 sporadic MMA trios (proband and unaffected parents) of predominantly European ancestry. An additional cohort of 200 probands was screened for gene recurrence. We applied a stringent filtering strategy to identify de novo and rare inherited variants, followed by gene prioritization based on structural modeling, expression data, and biological plausibility. Gene-based burden tests were conducted against large control databases (gnomAD). We identified causative variants in 20 of the 74 probands (27%). Six probands with severe syndromic infant-onset phenotypes harbored de novo variants in the E3 ligase domain of RNF213. Fourteen probands carried a causative copy number variant (n = 3) or a short variant (n = 11) in a known MMA-associated gene (CBL, NF1, PTPN11, DIAPH1, ANO1, JAG1, NOS3, HBB). Beyond these established genes, we identified strong candidate variants in 11 probands from the discovery cohort, involving 11 novel candidate genes. Screening the additional cohort of 200 unrelated MMA probands identified recurrence of the gain-of-function SMAD4 p.Arg496Cys variant, which was de novo in the discovery-cohort proband, linking MMA to dysregulated TGF-β signaling. Other candidate findings included de novo loss-of-function variants in genes regulating epigenetic modulation and RNA splicing (SETD2, HNRNPL, UBAP2L, TOP2B, PRPF40A) and variants affecting vascular stress response (EPAS1, SVEP1, PDCD4). RNF213 was the only gene reaching exome-wide significance in burden testing (P = 2.11 × 10⁻11). This study establishes that MMA in non-East Asian populations is characterized by a strong genetic heterogeneity. These findings expand the molecular landscape of MMA and highlight the utility of trio-based sequencing for uncovering very rare molecular players in this disease. Additional analyses will now be needed to investigate the convergence of MMA pathways.
abstract_zh: 摘要 茧状动脉病（MMA）是一种罕见的脑血管疾病，其特征是颅内动脉进行性狭窄以及异常侧支血管的形成。虽然RNF213是东亚人群中主要的易感基因，但RNF213之外MMA的遗传结构，尤其是在欧洲人群中，除少数已知的综合征病因外，仍大多不明确。我们对主要为欧洲血统的74个散发MMA三倍体家系（患儿及非受影响父母）进行了外显子组测序。另一组200名患儿的队列接受了基因复发性筛查。我们采用严格的筛选策略识别新生和罕见遗传变异，并基于结构建模、表达数据和生物学合理性进行基因优先级排序。基于大型控制数据库（gnomAD）进行了基因负担检验。我们在74名患者中鉴定出20名（27%）的致病变异。6名伴有重度综合征性婴儿发病表型的患者携带RNF213 E3连接酶结构域中的新生变异。14名患者携带已知MMA相关基因（CBL、NF1、PTPN11、DIAPH1、ANO1、JAG1、NOS3、HBB）中的致病拷贝数变异（n=3）或短变异（n=11）。在这些既定基因之外，我们在发现队列的11名患者中鉴定出强候选变异，涉及11个新候选基因。对另外200名非相关MMA患者队列的筛查发现，增强功能SMAD4 p.Arg496Cys变异复发，该变异在发现队列患者中为新生，将MMA与TGF-β信号失调联系起来。其他候选发现包括调控表观遗传修饰和RNA剪接基因（SETD2、HNRNPL、UBAP2L、TOP2B、PRPF40A）中的新生功能丧失变异，以及影响血管应激反应的变异（EPAS1、SVEP1、PDCD4）。RNF213是外显子组全局负担检验中唯一达到显著性的基因（P=2.11×10⁻¹¹）。本研究确立，非东亚人群中的MMA具有显著的遗传异质性。这些发现扩展了MMA的分子图谱，并突出了三倍体测序在揭示该疾病中非常罕见的分子参与者方面的效用。还需要进行进一步分析来研究MMA通路的交汇。
